title: How to Get Unlimited Leads From a List of Company Names
coverSub: From a list of company names to their websites
cover: In this video we are going to see how to turn a list of company names into leads using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 7 company names went in, and every one came back with its website, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, websites out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the people who work at these companies.
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API (data/lookups.json), checked by tools/gen360.py

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Click Company website. It costs one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type Gusto.
In a couple of seconds you get gusto dot com.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 7, from Rippling to MasterClass.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The websites come in row by row while you watch.
7 companies in, 7 websites out, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
